archetypes.name: dyn-postmerge-outcome
archetypes.rationale: Postmerge success must stay OK when best-effort flush skips
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect run_postmerge_phase after the RefreshSkip change. Confirm finalize_postmerge_logs is still invoked when eligible, RefreshSkip no longer stalls or writes postmerge-flush state, real finalize.postmerge failures still return their terminal outcome, and the regression test asserts DONE/OK without a skip warning breadcrumb. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
